artist.name: Gabrielle Aplin
artist.short_description: Gabrielle Aplin is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Gabrielle Aplin is an English singer-songwriter whose career began with online acoustic recordings and grew into a multi-album catalogue spanning folk-pop, indie-pop and more electronic textures. Her version of 'The Power of Love' was a major early breakthrough, but it is a cover and must be labeled as such, not as an original composition. The album English Rain followed in 2013 and established songs such as 'Please Don't Say You Love Me,' 'Home' and 'Panic Cord.' She then released Light Up the Dark, Dear Happy and Phosphorescent, while developing her independent label Never Fade Records. Across interviews, she has discussed deliberately changing her sound while retaining a focus on songs that work when stripped back to their core. For example, she described 'Waking Up Slow' as an effort to appreciate what is positive and present in life, while 'My Mistake' came from acknowledging difficult feelings without hiding them. Aplin offers Afterglow a rich bridge between acoustic songwriting and emotional-pop arrangements. Editorial descriptions should separate her original works, covers and collaborations and avoid assuming newer album dates are original recording dates.
